capabilities: Pair devices over LAN with a 6-digit code or QR scan
Compare differing files and choose push, pull, or skip per file
Sync automatically on a timer, live on edit, or manually
Filter synced files by extension and merge conflicting edits
Export the synced folder and transfer log as a ZIP backup
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that LAN transfers are unencrypted and should only be used on trusted networks, and that phones cannot host a server so mobile-to-desktop sync must be initiated from the phone.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync vaults directly between devices on a local network without a cloud service, account, or subscription.
summary: Peer-to-peer sync of a folder or whole vault between Obsidian devices over local WiFi, with pairing, file comparison, and auto-sync.
